title: gynochthodes philippinensis
intro: Gynochthodes philippinensis, commonly known as Philippine gynochthodes or Philippine gardenia, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Gynochthodes philippinensis include its ability to act as an antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-cough agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
